load_skill.description: Allows the model to load skills.
rules: JIN must load a skill before using it. Available skills listed inside <SKILLS_LIST> are titles only; load the skill to receive its full context.
Load exactly one skill per <LOAD_SKILL_CONTEXT> tag. To load multiple skills, emit a separate <LOAD_SKILL_CONTEXT>...</LOAD_SKILL_CONTEXT> tag for each skill.
